question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Help**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Help **is a verb that means to assist someone. (किसी की सहायता करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *She offered to help her neighbour carry groceries.*
 
 
 
• Help is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank because it
